author: Eternalll
name: IdentifyActivity
short: Find members by their current activity.
description: Search the server for members whose current activity (game, app, etc.) matches a piece of text. Results are shown in a paginated embed with back, close, and next buttons.
install_msg: Thanks for installing! Use `[p]identifyactivity <name>` to search. Requires the Presence and Server Members intents.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users.
